description: null at optional match keys means the same as omitting them.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name $$) AS (name agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name))
